name: 验证指标被截断或直接常量化
trigger: R2/accuracy/CV metrics are clipped to a preferred range or returned as constants rather than calculated from y_true/y_pred/folds
example: S044 Q3 R2 clamped to [0.75,0.95] and CV MSE/MAE/R2 hard-coded 30/4.5/0.78
gate: metrics must be pure functions of registered predictions/targets/splits; forbid score clamps except clearly labeled display transforms
